hooks.name: validate-project-files
hooks.description: Check project, version, preset, template and profile JSON against the Zod schemas when one is written.

hooks.name: schema-change-followups
hooks.description: When a schema changes, keep fixtures, the demo project, migrations and the Claude JSON Schemas in step.

action.prompt: You changed a schema. Update test fixtures, examples/demo.alcyo and examples/demo-profile.json, the JSON Schemas passed to claude -p --json-schema and the API fallback, and .kiro/specs/schema/design.md. Keep all times as integer ms. If old files no longer parse, bump schemaVersion and add a migration with a test. Then run pnpm plan:validate and pnpm test.
